texts.checkout.account_linked: Your payment will be linked to this account automatically. Use this email to access your downloads any time.
texts.checkout.account_tip: Optional: create a free account with this same email to save bookmarks, leave reviews, and re-download later.
texts.checkout.email_body: After payment, we email a full receipt to the address above — the book, amount paid, and your Paystack transaction details. Keep it; it's what we use to sort out any payment dispute.
texts.checkout.email_title: You'll get a receipt by email
texts.checkout.free_body: There's nothing to pay. Open the book to read it.
texts.checkout.guest_heading: You are not signed in — guest checkout
texts.checkout.guest_why: Your email is the only way to match your payment to your order if something goes wrong (failed payment, missing download, support request). It also lets you re-download your purchase later without paying again — just log in with the same address.

texts.install.help: On iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android: browser menu → Install app. That is how PlugYard stays on this phone.
texts.install.intro_account: You already have an account. Install so PlugYard opens like an app — not a browser tab you swipe away and never find again.
texts.install.intro_guest: A tab forgets you. Install PlugYard so the Kenyan library sits on your home screen. Then create a free account so your page, bookmarks, and purchases survive a new phone.
texts.install.point_account: A free account moves that place to another device, unlocks publishing and invite rewards, and lets us email you when a title is actually for you.
texts.install.point_home: One tap from the home screen, even after you close Chrome or Safari.
texts.install.point_place_account: Your place in a book, bookmarks, and purchases stay one tap away.
texts.install.point_place_guest: Keep the page you were on and the books you saved — without hunting for the site.
texts.install.title_account: Put your shelf on this phone
texts.install.title_guest: Don't lose this library in a tab
texts.invite.intro: Guests can browse. An account is how this library becomes yours — and how a Kenyan author gets a book on the shelf.

invite.points.label: Keep your place.
invite.points.value: Page 47 of a statute, a bookmark, a paid file — they follow you to the next phone instead of dying with this browser.

invite.points.label: Publish and earn.
invite.points.value: Upload a PDF, set a price or mark it free. When it sells, the publisher cut is yours. Ads and invite rewards only work on an account, because we have to know the book is yours.

invite.points.label: Get notes meant for you.
invite.points.value: We email and tap you when a title matches how you read, when you leave a book unfinished, or when someone uses your invite — not a blast to everyone.

texts.invite.title: Why create a PlugYard account

texts.notfound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. The shelf is still open.
texts.notfound.title: This page isn't here
texts.off.ads: Ads are paused for now. Your ad balance is kept, and nothing is charged while ads are off.
texts.off.affiliate: Invite rewards are paused for now. Rewards already earned stay in your wallet.
texts.off.boosts: Boosts are paused for now. Boosts already running finish as paid.
texts.off.guest_checkout: Buying without an account is paused for now. Sign in or create a free account to buy. Earlier guest purchases still open from their email link.
texts.off.pro_signups: New Pro subscriptions are paused for now. If you already have Pro, it keeps working until it ends.
texts.off.publishing: Publishing new books is paused for now. Your published books stay on sale.
texts.off.reviews: New ratings and comments are paused for now.

pro.benefits.label: Floating pop-out reader & player
pro.benefits.value: Keep your audiobook playing and your page floating even when you switch apps or minimize the browser. Audio continues in the background — close or navigate away from the tab to stop it.

pro.benefits.label: AI narration, any page
pro.benefits.value: Have any page read aloud in a natural voice — pick from four distinct voices, control speed, and follow along with auto-scroll and sentence highlighting as it reads. Narration stops automatically when you close or navigate away from the tab.

texts.pro.headline: Read and listen without limits
texts.publish.guest_intro: Publishing needs an account so the title, the payout, and the invite reward attach to a real person — not a browser tab. Create one to upload a PDF, set a price or mark it free, and earn when readers buy. Install PlugYard afterwards if you want to check sales and reviews from your home screen.
texts.publish.intro: Required: front, spine, back, and PDF. Audio is optional. An admin reviews before it goes on the shelf.
texts.publish.sneak_help: Sneak view is the number of pages a visitor can read before buying. Example: 4 means the first four pages only. Use 0 to turn sneak view off.
texts.purchases.guest_body: Enter the email you used at checkout and we'll email you a fresh secure link to your books. Your purchases never expire — only the link does.
texts.push.account_body: Notifications are how PlugYard finds you after you close the site. We send a note written for you — here and by email — when you leave a page unfinished, when a new title matches how you read, or when someone uses your invite. That is the point of an account: the library can remember you.
texts.push.account_title: {name}, get a tap when a book is actually yours
texts.push.guest_body: Without an account, PlugYard cannot keep your place or email you. Allow alerts on this phone now, then create a free account so the same personal notes follow you — unfinished pages, titles in your category, and invite rewards — instead of a generic blast.
texts.push.guest_title: Hear about a title before it disappears into the shelf
